notes.title: Counter Agents Update and ConSPYration Announcement!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce an update for Counter Agents!

This patch includes:

[list]
[*] Upgraded Lighting.
[*] Upgraded VFX.
[*] Updated input system to allow additional options for controller support.
[*] Performance improvement.
[*] General UI updates and quality of life improvements.
[/list]

The developers behind Counter Agents are also thrilled to announce "ConSPYration", a new fast paced local multiplayer stealth game directly inspired by Counter Agents! Check it out on Steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485890/ConSPYration/

notes.title: Inspired by Counter Agents, New game "ConSPYration" is now on Steam!
notes.content:
Thank you, all Counter Agents players around the world! The developers behind Counter Agents have been thrilled to see your joy and entertainment this game has brought you over the years! 

Now, from the devs behind Counter Agents, Moon Tales Studios is excited to bring you "ConSPYration", a new spy-themed local multiplayer game directly inspired by Counter Agents!

ConSPYration utilizes and improves on all of the best elements of Counter Agents. With character options, team color selections, up to 6 local players (up to 4 on keyboard, up to 6 on gamepad), and over 30 playable levels, swiping the briefcase before your friends has never felt so good!

We hope you check out ConSPYration and let us know how you like it!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485890/ConSPYration/]ConSPYraion is now on the Steam store here![/url]
